newsitem.title: UK: M. Stanley sees strong Russia rally on Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: M. Stanley sees strong Russia rally on Eurobond.

text.p: Russia's billion dollar Eurobond issue will precipitate a strong and sustained rally in the MinFin market, Morgan Stanley emerging markets fixed income analyst Eric Fine said in a note to investors.
"Russia's Eurobond provides a new anchor for the country's yield curve at tight levels relative to outstanding fixed income assets," Fine said.

He sees MinFins tightening by as much as 216 basis points. He expects the MinFin 4s to tighten by 151 basis points by May 31 next year, generating a total annualised return of 33.20 percent and the 5s to tighten by 106 basis points for a return of 32.90 percent.
Russian dollar Vneshekonombank principals are also expected to benefit, tightening by 180 basis points to generate a total annualised return of 56 percent.
"Such a tightening would see the principals appreciate to a price of roughly 68 from current prices of around 59," Fine said -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
